en.title_tag: Electrolux Washing Machine Error E71: Safe Steps
en.meta_description: Electrolux washer showing E71? Check the verified meaning, safe user actions and when authorised service is required.
en.h1: What Does E71 Mean on an Electrolux Washing Machine?
en.description: Official Electrolux service documentation identifies E71 as a washing-temperature NTC sensor signal outside limits, caused by a short/open sensor, wiring or control-board fault.
en.quick_fix: Switch off, unplug and arrange authorised Electrolux service; do not open the washer or test sensors, wiring or electronics (about 5–30 minutes).
en.intro_html:
Official Electrolux service documentation identifies E71 as a washing-temperature NTC sensor signal outside limits, caused by a short/open sensor, wiring or control-board fault.

Switch off, unplug and arrange authorised Electrolux service; do not open the washer or test sensors, wiring or electronics. Record the complete code and PNC/product number and do not order a part from the code alone.

causes_json.detail: Official Electrolux service documentation identifies E71 as a washing-temperature NTC sensor signal outside limits, caused by a short/open sensor, wiring or control-board fault.
The PNC identifies the correct electronics platform and service data.
Circuits behind panels must be checked only by a trained technician.
The code identifies a system but does not confirm which part needs replacement.

steps_json.detail: Wait for the drum to stop. Do not force the door or handle water that may be hot.
Close the water tap and unplug with dry hands if the area is dry.
Photograph the complete E71 display and note the PNC/product number and programme stage.
Switch off, unplug and arrange authorised Electrolux service; do not open the washer or test sensors, wiring or electronics.
For EF0, make one test after foam subsides and visible causes are corrected only if there is no leakage or other warning sign.
Request service directly for E71/E91/E92/E94 and for recurring EF0. Do not remove panels.

en.when_to_call_technician_html:
E71 requires authorised service when it is an E71/E9 code or when EF0 returns after documented external checks. Do not use the washer when leaking.

Stop immediately for water near electricity, burning smell, smoke, abnormal heat or tripped protection.
en.prevention_html:
Dose detergent for water hardness and load, mix large and small items and keep the dispenser, door opening and visible hose connections clean and watertight.

Internal sensor, communication and configuration faults cannot be safely prevented or diagnosed through user maintenance.

faq_json.question: Can I keep using a Bosch washer showing E71?
faq_json.answer: Switch off, unplug and arrange authorised Electrolux service; do not open the washer or test sensors, wiring or electronics. Do not run another cycle until Bosch guidance or service confirms it is safe.

faq_json.question: Can I reset E71 by switching the washer off?
faq_json.answer: Switching off is a safety step, not proof that the fault is repaired. If the code returns or Bosch classifies it as service-only, do not repeatedly reset the washer.

faq_json.question: Does E71 identify a part to replace?
faq_json.answer: No. The code identifies a system or condition, but Bosch service should diagnose the exact cause before any part is ordered.

faq_json.question: Why should I provide the E-Nr?
faq_json.answer: Bosch model families and markets can use different hardware and service procedures. The E-Nr identifies the correct appliance documentation.

faq_json.question: May I test the sensor myself?
faq_json.answer: No. Do not remove panels or measure internal wiring, sensors or electronics. Bosch directs these codes to customer service.

sv.title_tag: Electrolux tvättmaskin felkod E71: säkra steg
sv.meta_description: Visar Electrolux-tvättmaskinen E71? Läs verifierad betydelse, säkra kontroller och när auktoriserad service krävs.
sv.h1: Vad betyder E71 på en Electrolux-tvättmaskin?
sv.description: Officiell electrolux-servicedokumentation anger att e71 betyder att tvättens ntc-temperaturgivarsignal ligger utanför gränserna på grund av kortsluten/öppen givare, kablage eller styrkort.
sv.quick_fix: Stäng av, dra ur kontakten och boka auktoriserad Electrolux-service; öppna inte maskinen och testa inte givare, kablage eller elektronik (cirka 5–30 minuter).
sv.intro_html:
Officiell electrolux-servicedokumentation anger att e71 betyder att tvättens ntc-temperaturgivarsignal ligger utanför gränserna på grund av kortsluten/öppen givare, kablage eller styrkort.

Stäng av, dra ur kontakten och boka auktoriserad Electrolux-service; öppna inte maskinen och testa inte givare, kablage eller elektronik. Dokumentera hela koden och PNC-/produktnumret och beställ inte en reservdel från koden ensam.

causes_json.detail: Officiell electrolux-servicedokumentation anger att e71 betyder att tvättens ntc-temperaturgivarsignal ligger utanför gränserna på grund av kortsluten/öppen givare, kablage eller styrkort.
PNC identifierar rätt elektronikplattform och servicedata.
Kretsar bakom paneler ska endast kontrolleras av utbildad tekniker.
Koden pekar ut ett system men bekräftar inte vilken del som ska bytas.

steps_json.detail: Vänta tills trumman står stilla. Tvinga inte luckan och hantera inte vatten som kan vara varmt.
Stäng vattenkranen och dra ur kontakten med torra händer om området är torrt.
Fotografera hela E71-visningen och notera PNC-/produktnummer och programfas.
Stäng av, dra ur kontakten och boka auktoriserad Electrolux-service; öppna inte maskinen och testa inte givare, kablage eller elektronik.

steps_json.action: Testa bara när det är säkert
steps_json.detail: För EF0 kan ett enda test göras efter att skum lagt sig och synliga orsaker åtgärdats, om inget läckage eller annan varningssignal finns.
Boka direkt för E71/E91/E92/E94 och för EF0 som återkommer. Ta inte bort paneler.

sv.when_to_call_technician_html:
E71 kräver auktoriserad service om det är en E71/E9-kod eller om EF0 återkommer efter dokumenterade yttre kontroller. Använd inte maskinen vid läckage.

Avbryt direkt vid vatten nära el, bränd lukt, rök, onormal värme eller utlöst elskydd.
sv.prevention_html:
Dosera tvättmedel efter vattenhårdhet och last, fördela stora och små plagg och håll dispenser, lucköppning och synliga slanganslutningar rena och täta.

Interna givarfel, kommunikationsfel och konfigurationsfel kan inte förebyggas eller diagnostiseras säkert genom användarunderhåll.

faq_json.question: Kan jag fortsätta använda maskinen med E71?
faq_json.answer: Stäng av, dra ur kontakten och boka auktoriserad Electrolux-service; öppna inte maskinen och testa inte givare, kablage eller elektronik. Kör inte ett nytt program innan Bosch eller en servicetekniker har bekräftat att det är säkert.

faq_json.question: Kan jag återställa E71 genom att stänga av?
faq_json.answer: Avstängning är en säkerhetsåtgärd, inte bevis på att felet är löst. Återställ inte maskinen upprepade gånger om koden återkommer.

faq_json.question: Visar E71 vilken reservdel som ska bytas?
faq_json.answer: Nej. Koden identifierar ett system eller tillstånd, men Bosch service ska diagnostisera den exakta orsaken före beställning.

faq_json.question: Varför behöver Bosch E‑Nr?
faq_json.answer: Bosch-serier och marknader kan ha olika maskinvara och serviceförfaranden. E‑Nr identifierar rätt dokumentation.

faq_json.question: Kan jag själv testa sensorn?
faq_json.answer: Nej. Ta inte bort paneler och mät inte interna ledningar, sensorer eller elektronik. Bosch hänvisar dessa koder till service.

en.title_tag: Electrolux Washing Machine Error EF0: Safe Steps
en.meta_description: Electrolux washer showing EF0? Check the verified meaning, safe user actions and when authorised service is required.
en.h1: What Does EF0 Mean on an Electrolux Washing Machine?
en.description: Electrolux states that EF0 can be triggered by water leakage, excessive foam, an unbalanced load or an appliance malfunction.
en.quick_fix: Switch off, turn off the water tap and disconnect safely; check visible leakage, trapped laundry, detergent dose, load balance and user-accessible connections as the exact manual describes (about 5–30 minutes).
en.intro_html:
Electrolux states that EF0 can be triggered by water leakage, excessive foam, an unbalanced load or an appliance malfunction.

Switch off, turn off the water tap and disconnect safely; check visible leakage, trapped laundry, detergent dose, load balance and user-accessible connections as the exact manual describes. Record the complete code and PNC/product number and do not order a part from the code alone.

causes_json.detail: Overdosing can interfere with level sensing and prevent spinning.
One large item or a few items may not distribute and the washer repeats spin attempts.
Check only hose connections, filter area, door seal and trapped laundry covered by the manual.
Recurring EF0 after safe checks requires authorised service.

steps_json.detail: Wait for the drum to stop. Do not force the door or handle water that may be hot.
Close the water tap and unplug with dry hands if the area is dry.
Photograph the complete EF0 display and note the PNC/product number and programme stage.
Switch off, turn off the water tap and disconnect safely; check visible leakage, trapped laundry, detergent dose, load balance and user-accessible connections as the exact manual describes.
For EF0, make one test after foam subsides and visible causes are corrected only if there is no leakage or other warning sign.
Request service directly for E71/E91/E92/E94 and for recurring EF0. Do not remove panels.

en.when_to_call_technician_html:
EF0 requires authorised service when it is an E71/E9 code or when EF0 returns after documented external checks. Do not use the washer when leaking.

Stop immediately for water near electricity, burning smell, smoke, abnormal heat or tripped protection.
en.prevention_html:
Dose detergent for water hardness and load, mix large and small items and keep the dispenser, door opening and visible hose connections clean and watertight.

Internal sensor, communication and configuration faults cannot be safely prevented or diagnosed through user maintenance.

faq_json.question: Can I keep using a Bosch washer showing EF0?
faq_json.answer: Switch off, turn off the water tap and disconnect safely; check visible leakage, trapped laundry, detergent dose, load balance and user-accessible connections as the exact manual describes. Do not run another cycle until Bosch guidance or service confirms it is safe.

faq_json.question: Can I reset EF0 by switching the washer off?
faq_json.answer: Switching off is a safety step, not proof that the fault is repaired. If the code returns or Bosch classifies it as service-only, do not repeatedly reset the washer.

faq_json.question: Does EF0 identify a part to replace?
faq_json.answer: No. The code identifies a system or condition, but Bosch service should diagnose the exact cause before any part is ordered.

faq_json.question: Why should I provide the E-Nr?
faq_json.answer: Bosch model families and markets can use different hardware and service procedures. The E-Nr identifies the correct appliance documentation.

faq_json.question: May I test the sensor myself?
faq_json.answer: No. Do not remove panels or measure internal wiring, sensors or electronics. Bosch directs these codes to customer service.
